top_signals.title: Putin says EU is losing industry, falling behind competition, ahead of meeting with Trump and Xi
top_signals.summary: Putin used the speech to emphasize Russia's economic resilience despite U.S. sanctions, and played up opportunities for APEC members in the country.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India’s Stock Rally Faces Valuation Test as Bond Allure Grows
top_signals.summary: India’s stock rebound is approaching a crucial valuation test as rising bond yields make sovereign debt an increasingly viable alternative to equities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
